messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have blood in your urine"
set: ["call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have blood in your urine", "seek emergency medical attention for blood in urine", "seek emergency medical attention or call your doctor right away", "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you have black or bloody stools", "seek emergency medical attention", "call doctor if have blood in urine", "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you cough up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds", "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood", "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention", "emergency medical attention", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head", "seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms such as chest pain or pressure", "call your doctor right away if you have dark colored urine", "seek medical attention if you think your medications are not working", "contact doctor or seek emergency medical attention for uncontrolled bleeding", "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [

    "call your doctor or seek emergency medical attention if you cough up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds",
    "seek emergency medical attention for coughing up blood",
    "caregiver should seek emergency medical attention",

    "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if fall or hit head",
    "seek emergency medical attention if you have symptoms such as chest pain or pressure",
    "call your doctor right away if you have dark colored urine",
    "seek medical attention if you think your medications are not working",
    "contact doctor or seek emergency medical attention for uncontrolled bleeding",
    "tell doctor or seek emergency medical attention if bleeding will not stop"
  ],
  "alias": "seek emergency medical attention"
}
